plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Xeebs's usual queue AND best role at 53.3% over 331 games (overall is 50.5%).
Stop queueing carry: 42.9% over 198 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 6.4 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 39% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo, Serath for ranked: 37% over 51; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 475 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)

winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 80%. Past 32: 58%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 16 of 20 short games vs 7 of 12 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
